## RM compatibility

- Port PR #3 by B0L1V3RS with bounded reads and raw bitmap drawing.
- Preserve the zero format byte used by the bundled uncompressed `.bm` files.
- Reject invalid sizes and failed reads before drawing.

## v0.2 – 2025-09-23
### Fixed
- Corrected image rendering: removed unnecessary bit-reversal and dummy byte so
  now it correctly displays `.fbm` files generated by **img2fbm v0.2.2**.
  *Tested on the official Flipper firmware Release 1.3.4 (Build 2025-04-22).*
